name: sctwas_atlas

relevance.justification: Directly aligned with BioThings entity types: integrates gene (Ensembl IDs), disease/trait (EFO/MONDO ontology, MeSH), cell type (Cell Ontology CL IDs), and variant (rsID SNPs) identifiers. Covers 2,765,211 single-cell TWAS associations across 34 traits, 30 cell types, 9 conditions, and 16,470 genes. Links sc-eQTL with GWAS — a multi-omics regulatory network directly relevant to gene-disease-variant relationships.

novelty.justification: scTWAS associations at single-cell resolution are novel to BioThings. Existing BioThings sources (e.g., DisGeNET, HPO in MyDisease; dbSNP/ClinVar in MyVariant; NCBI/Ensembl in MyGene) lack cell-type-specific TWAS associations. The sc-eQTL data (127M+ variants, 21 cell types) is a novel layer not replicated elsewhere in BioThings. Some GWAS trait annotations overlap with existing BioThings ontology sources, but the scTWAS link (gene-trait-celltype) is genuinely new.

openness.justification: FAIL — The 2.7M core TWAS associations are NOT available for bulk download; they are stored in MySQL and only accessible via web interface search/filter. The downloadable files (eQTL data, metadata) are the input data, not the value-added scTWAS results. License is CC-BY-NC 4.0 (permits non-commercial redistribution) but the bulk export of the core database is not provided. This makes plugin generation using manifest-based bulk download impossible for the primary data.

evidence.scope: 2,765,211 single-cell TWAS associations spanning 34 traits, 30 cell types, 9 cell conditions, 16,470 genes. Integrates 10 sc-eQTL datasets with GWAS summary statistics from 5 publications. Multi-omics regulatory network linking genes, traits, cell types, and variants.
evidence.overlap: Gene annotations overlap with MyGene.info (Ensembl IDs). Trait ontology (EFO/MONDO/MeSH) overlaps with MyDisease.info. rsID SNPs overlap with MyVariant.info. The novel layer — cell-type-specific TWAS scores — is not in any existing BioThings API.

api_info.notes: No public REST API documented. Data access is through web interface only. The 2.7M TWAS associations are stored in MySQL and accessible only via the web search/browse interface.

risks: Core TWAS association data (2.7M records) is NOT bulk downloadable — only browsable via web interface
CC-BY-NC 4.0 restricts commercial use by downstream API consumers
Only downloadable data is sc-eQTL input files (~133MB), not the scTWAS association outputs
Server hosted at CNCB (Chinese National Center for Bioinformatics) — may have intermittent international access
next_actions: Contact scTWAS authors to request bulk data export of TWAS associations
Alternatively, ingest the sc-eQTL data (Allstudies_sig_eQTL.txt, ~1.3M rows) as a useful subset — these are the input eQTLs, not the scTWAS outputs
Flag as api_only_backlog for TWAS associations until bulk download is available
